name: Elementalist
description: A master of elemental magic who conjures living fire, ice, and lightning spirits to overwhelm enemies with raw elemental power.
lore: Trained at the Planar Convergence Academy, Elementalists learn to tear open tiny rifts to the elemental planes and bind the spirits within. Each elemental is a fragment of pure destructive force given shape and purpose.

abilities.name: Elemental Spark
abilities.description: Launches a spark of elemental energy at a single enemy. Damage type matches the last summoned elemental, defaulting to fire.

abilities.name: Summon Fire Elemental
abilities.description: Summons a fire elemental that attacks with fire damage and radiates a burning aura for 4 turns.

abilities.name: Elemental Shield
abilities.description: Conjures a shimmering elemental barrier that increases Fire, Ice, and Lightning Resistance by 20% for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Summon Ice Elemental
abilities.description: Summons an ice elemental that slows all enemies by 20% and attacks with ice damage for 4 turns.

abilities.name: Summon Lightning Elemental
abilities.description: Summons a lightning elemental whose attacks chain to 2 additional enemies for 4 turns.

abilities.name: Elemental Convergence
abilities.description: Combines the power of active elementals into a devastating AoE blast dealing 2x damage. Requires at least 2 elementals active. Reduces all enemy resistances by 15% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Planar Attunement
abilities.description: Passive: All elemental summons last 1 extra turn. Gain 10% Magic ATK for each active elemental. Gain 5% additional Fire, Ice, and Lightning Resistance.

abilities.name: Primordial Storm
abilities.description: Ultimate: Tears open a rift to all three elemental planes simultaneously, dealing 2.5x multi-elemental damage to all enemies, summoning all three elementals, and applying fire, ice, and lightning DoT for 3 turns.

synergies: Witch: Curse-reduced resistances make elemental damage devastatingly effective
Auramancer: Damage amplification auras boost both Elementalist and elemental summon damage
Necromancer: Combined summon armies overwhelm enemies with sheer numbers
weaknesses: The most fragile summoner — negative physical resistance and very low STA
Requires multiple turns to set up a full elemental army
Highest MP costs of any class — runs dry without mana support
Elemental Convergence is wasted if elementals are killed before it can be used
hire_description: Three tiny spirits — one of crackling flame, one of shimmering ice, one of buzzing lightning — orbit a calm figure reading at a table. They look up with glowing eyes. "Three elements, one will. Shall I show you what convergence looks like?"
